newsitem.title: LITHUANIA: LITHUANIA-MINISTER SAYS INVITES SENT ON TELECOM SALE.
newsitem.headline: LITHUANIA-MINISTER SAYS INVITES SENT ON TELECOM SALE.

text.p: European Affairs Minister Laima Andrikiene said on Friday that invites have already been sent to companies and investment houses interested in drawing up the privatisation plans for state-owned Lithuanian Telecom.
She told a news conference that the companies would have two months to draw up the plans although the firms invited to draw up the plan would not be allowed to take part in the sale.
Lithuania has earlier said the government will keep no more than 34 percent of the telecoms firm and five percent will be sold to the employees at a discounted price.

The programme should include details on how long the privatisation will take, what price the government will get, whether to keep telecom as the monopoly provider and a development plan for the company.
Andrikiene said that according to research by Banque Paribas, Lithuania could gain between one billion dollars and $500 million depending on the method of privatisation chosen.
